module: Manages the bounds of the career tutorial zone. It checks that the player stays within the active zones of the tutorial sites; otherwise it displays a warning with a 5 s countdown in the task list, then triggers an automatic return via callbacks (onCareerTutorial... hooks). Can also draw the active zones in debug.
notes: Constants: 5 s countdown (OOB_AUTO_RESET_SECONDS), "automatic return" message displayed 1 s before the timeout callback.

Default callbacks: onOutOfBoundsStarted -> hook onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsStarted; onOutOfBoundsEnded -> onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsEnded; onOutOfBoundsTimedOut(stepId) -> hook onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsTimedOut if the current step is '04timeTrial', otherwise onCareerTutorialLeftBounds; onOutOfBoundsWhileNotAllowed -> onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.
Without an active zone or without loaded sites, the player is always considered within bounds.
The warning texts are in English and hardcoded (no translation key).
The tested position is that of player 0's vehicle, or the camera if there is none.
Tracking is inactive as long as the runtime's activity getter (setRuntimeActiveGetter) returns false.

setRuntimeActiveGetter.desc: Sets the function that indicates whether the tutorial is active. A non-function value resets it to a function returning false.

getter.desc: Function with no argument returning a boolean.

setCurrentStepGetter.desc: Sets the function that returns the current tutorial step identifier (passed to the timeout callback).

getter.desc: Function with no argument returning the step id (string) or nil.

setCallbacks.desc: Replaces all or some of the out-of-bounds callbacks; absent keys keep their current callback.

newCallbacks.desc: Possible keys: onOutOfBoundsStarted, onOutOfBoundsEnded, onOutOfBoundsTimedOut(currentStepId), onOutOfBoundsWhileNotAllowed.

setSites.desc: Sets the sites object (with zones) used to test the bounds. If it is nil, update loads it from gameplay_tutorial_setup.

newSites.desc: Sites object with sites.zones.byName / sites.zones.objects or the getZonesForPosition method.

setActiveZones.desc: Sets the list of zones in which the player is allowed (replaces the previous list).

names.desc: Zone names; nil clears the list (no more limit).

setZoneEnabled.desc: Temporarily enables or disables a zone without removing it from the active list.

getZoneEnabled.desc: Indicates whether a zone is enabled (true by default if never set).

getActiveZoneNames.desc: Returns the sorted list of active zone names.

getEnabledZones.desc: Returns the internal zoneEnabled table (name -> boolean), direct reference.

setDebugDrawBounds.desc: Enables or disables the debug drawing of the active zones (semi-transparent yellow), done in onPreRender.

getDebugDrawBounds.desc: Indicates whether the debug drawing of the zones is active.

isInBounds.desc: Indicates whether the player is within bounds. Returns true if the tutorial is not active.

returns.desc: true if in an active and enabled zone (or if there is nothing to check).

update.desc: To call every frame: if the tutorial is active, tests the bounds; when out of bounds, displays the warning with countdown, and after 5 s triggers (via a job with a 1 s pause) the onOutOfBoundsTimedOut callback. If automatic return is not allowed (gameplay_tutorial_setup.isOutOfBoundsResetAllowed), only calls onOutOfBoundsWhileNotAllowed.

onPreRender.desc: Render hook called every frame; draws the active zones if debug is enabled and the tutorial is active.

cleanup.desc: Leaves the out-of-bounds state and resets sites, active zones, disabled zones and debug.
